issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync on hot error-formatting path with no cache.
issues.detail: getSourceMap runs per external frame during error serialization and does readFileSync on both the source and its referenced .map, with no memoization. Noisy failures multiply disk reads. Add a Map<file, SourceMap|null> cache and/or move to async I/O so reporter postcondition of non-blocking error formatting holds.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes resolvedSources contract with no direct unit test.
issues.detail: The change matches spec (resolve against map's parent dir) but assumes `from` is a file path; URLs, empty, or directory inputs yield wrong results. DecodedMap is shared utility code with no test in packages/utils covering this. Prefer path.dirname(from) for clarity, document the precondition, and add a direct unit test for resolvedSources.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns literal '{}' as a sentinel for missing map files.
issues.detail: Returning the string '{}' makes convert-source-map parse an empty object and silently succeed, conflating 'file missing' with 'empty map' and leaking a dependency quirk. It hides real failures (broken sourceMappingURL, missing .map). Return undefined/null and let the caller decide on absence, or log at debug.

issues.description: Source-map helpers live in test-run.ts but belong in packages/utils/src/source-map.
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are stateless source-map transforms with nothing to do with TestRun orchestration. Move them next to DecodedMap in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts so module boundaries match responsibility and TestRun depends only on the abstraction.

issues.description: readFileSync on error path is not wrapped in try/catch.
issues.detail: existsSync + readFileSync is racy and readFileSync can throw (EACCES, EISDIR, symlink loop). If it throws inside the getSourceMap callback, error reporting dies and the user sees a sourcemap error instead of their actual test failure. Wrap in try/catch and fall through to no source map.

issues.description: Missing negative-path tests for the new getSourceMap contract.
issues.detail: The snapshot pins the success case but nothing covers failure modes: missing map, malformed map, moved file, throwing readFileSync. Add tests that when getSourceMap returns undefined, stacks fall back to the transpiled location, so the contract is enforced and won't silently regress.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix is directionally correct: external-module stack frames now resolve to original sources, and the DecodedMap resolve change matches sourcemap spec. But the implementation has three substantive issues: synchronous, uncached readFileSync on a hot error-formatting path; an unstated/leaky contract on the new getSourceMap hook including a fake '{}' sentinel that hides missing maps; and a shared-utility change with no direct unit test. Secondary cleanup: move the source-map helpers into packages/utils, wrap reads in try/catch, and add negative-path tests. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK before landing — small, well-scoped fixes, not architectural rework.
